children: Beeline launched a Rate Optimization Program offering a $3,000 lender credit to accelerate Bank Statement Non‑QM mortgage growth as Q3 revenue trends toward one of its strongest quarters.
$3,000 lender credit for qualifying Bank Statement purchase and refinance loans of $250,000+ locked by October 31, 2026.
Program aims to lower costs or buy down rates for self‑employed and non‑traditional income borrowers to spur volume.
Beeline shifted strategy in May 2026 toward higher‑margin Non‑QM products (Bank Statement, DSCR) to improve loan economics.
Q2 2026 revenue was $2.6M, up 57% YoY; July and August saw the company’s highest monthly margins to date.
Company is using AI from MagicBlocks to identify prospects, boost lead engagement and increase conversion for Non‑QM loans.
